author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
There are 3 types of time in AI coding

1. Human time - you need to eat and sleep, and you have to spend time with family and relax

2. Machine time - a traditional program can run fast and long, but it is rigid.

3. AI time - it is slow, but it works 24x7 and it won't get bored.

The key idea is use human time to convert AI time into machine time.
